title: Digraphs: sh, ch, th, wh
subject: Language Arts
description: Two letters team up to make ONE new sound!
steps: A digraph is TWO letters that make ONE sound together.
SH says /sh/ like in ship and shell. 🐚
CH says /ch/ like in chair and cheese. TH says /th/ like in think and this.
WH says /wh/ like in whale and wheel. 🐋

questions.correct: Two letters that make one sound
questions.hint: Di- means two, and they team up for one sound.
options: Two letters that make one sound

questions.prompt: Which digraph do you hear at the start of 'ship'?
questions.hint: Sh! Like asking someone to be quiet.

questions.prompt: Which word starts with the /ch/ sound?
Pick ALL the words that have the 'th' digraph!
questions.hint: Look for t and h side by side.
